verdict.rationale: Phaser documents official MCP servers on its own pages: the Phaser Game Agent MCP server lets you build games from the editor you already use (phaser.io/agent/mcp), and the Phaser Editor MCP Server offers 40+ specialised tools. Both work with Claude Desktop, Cursor, GitHub Copilot and other MCP clients, and a probe confirms the hosted MCP endpoint exists. That probe also shows there is no npm MCP package and that the site needs a browser UA, which narrows how it is distributed but does not contradict the capability. missing for 10: detailed connection/auth setup docs and an enumerated tool reference in the evidence, independent community hands-on corroboration.
